name: Youth Employment Services (Youth Job Center)
what_you_do: Get help with job searches, resumes and interviews. There is also mentoring and programs to explore kinds of work. Job placement gives teens income.
who_can_apply: Teens and young adults ages 14 to 21 (from the Briarpatch home page). The program page does not list other eligibility rules.
pay_detail: Pay rates are not listed. Placements are described as giving income.
deadline_text: No deadlines are posted. Fill out the referral form any time.
how_to_apply: Complete the online referral form on the program page. Questions: yjc@briarpatch.org, or call or text (608) 444-9413.
notes: The home page says the program also gives information on work permits, but no permit rules were read. Office: 2720 Rimrock Road, Fitchburg.
